name: Elon Musk
summary: Engineer and founder with 25+ years building hardware and software companies across space, energy and AI. Takes ideas from first-principles design to mass production, leading teams of thousands. Interested in applying large-scale engineering thinking to club projects.

education.thesis: Ultracapacitors for Electric Vehicle Energy Storage

bullets.text: Accelerating the World's Transition to Sustainable Energy
children: Led the development of the Model S, Model 3, Model X, and Model Y, scaling electric vehicle production to millions of units annually.
Oversaw the integration of vertical integration in battery production and the development of the 4680 battery cell.
Developed and deployed Full Self-Driving (FSD) Beta, utilizing a vision-only neural network approach to achieve general autonomy.
Managed the global expansion of Supercharger networks to enable long-distance electric travel.
Spearheaded the development of SolarRoof and Powerwall, creating a distributed energy ecosystem for residential and commercial use.
Scaled Megapack for utility-scale energy storage, replacing fossil-fuel peaking plants with sustainable alternatives.
Optimized the Tesla Energy ecosystem to maximize efficiency in power distribution.
Directed the development of Optimus, a humanoid robot designed to replace repetitive and dangerous labor.
Integrated advanced vision-based AI into humanoid form factors for real-world application.
Designed and developed the Falcon 1, Falcon 9, and Falcon Heavy, the first reusable orbital-class rockets.
Led the development of Starship, the most powerful launch vehicle ever built, designed for Mars colonization.
Developed the Dragon spacecraft for crewed missions to the ISS, restoring US crew launch capability.
Deployed the Starlink constellation of thousands of satellites to provide high-speed internet globally.
Pioneered the use of stainless steel for orbital-class spacecraft to reduce cost and increase durability.
Developed orbital refueling technology to enable deep-space missions to the Moon and Mars.
Established a cadence of rapid prototyping and iterative testing for spacecraft development.

bullets.text: Transforming X into the Everything App
children: Restructured the platform's engineering organization to optimize performance and reduce technical debt.
Implemented a new monetization model based on verified subscriptions to reduce reliance on advertising.
Introduced features for long-form content, video-first communication, and integrated financial services.
Integrated Grok AI into the X platform to provide real-time, unfiltered information to users.
Pioneered the first scalable online payment system, revolutionizing the global financial system.
Merged X.com with Confinity to create PayPal, facilitating the world's first mass-market digital wallet.
Developed the early infrastructure for digital currency transfer and fraud detection.

projects.title: Neuralink
projects.subtitle: Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)
bullets: Developed a high-bandwidth brain-computer interface to treat neurological conditions and achieve symbiosis with AI.
Created a precision robotic system for surgical implantation of ultra-thin electrodes into the motor cortex.
Implemented advanced signal processing to translate neural activity into digital commands.
Obtained FDA approval for first human clinical trials of the Link implant.

projects.title: The Boring Company
projects.subtitle: Infrastructure & Tunneling
bullets: Designed the 'Loop' high-speed transportation system to solve urban congestion via underground tunnels.
Developed high-speed tunneling machines (Prufrock) to reduce the cost and speed of tunneling by 10x.
Implemented autonomous electric vehicles for transit within the tunnel networks.
Created a scalable model for underground utility corridors to reduce urban surface disruption.

projects.title: OpenAI
projects.subtitle: Non-profit AI Research
bullets: Co-founded OpenAI to ensure that artificial general intelligence (AGI) is developed safely and for the benefit of all humanity.
Provided initial seed funding and guidance on AI safety and alignment.
Advocated for the development of open-source AI to prevent the concentration of power in a few large corporations.

activities.title: Chief Engineer
activities.subtitle: Tesla Bot / Optimus
bullets: Designing a general-purpose humanoid robot capable of performing dangerous, repetitive, or boring tasks.
Integrating Tesla's FSD computer and vision-based AI into a humanoid form factor.
Leading the development of actuators and sensors for high-precision humanoid movement.

activities.title: Founder
activities.subtitle: xAI
bullets: Developing Grok, a real-time AI that has access to the X platform for the most laest information.
Developing a massive GPU cluster for training next-generation LLMs.
Implementing a search-augmented generation (RAG) architecture to ensure the AI has real-time access to the world's events.
